channel.description: Latest articles from Ink Free News (inkfreenews.com)

item.title: Columbia City, 11 Other New Indiana Main Street Designations Announced
item.description: Columbia City Connect is one of 12 organizations the Office of Lieutenant Governor Micah Beckwith and the Indiana Office of Community and Rural Affairs announced have been recognized as Indiana Main Street programs or have moved into a new Indiana Main Street level.

item.title: Warsaw Community Public Library – Carnegie Roots Yield A $10,000 Gift
item.description: The Warsaw Community Public Library is honored to be one of the public libraries across the nation to receive a $10,000 gift from the Carnegie Corp. of New York as part of the Carnegie Libraries 250 celebration.

item.title: Winona Lake Senior Center Plans Open House, Lunch For March 19
item.description: The Winona Lake Senior Center is inviting seniors from across the community to attend a special open house and welcome lunch, designed to introduce area residents to the programs, activities and opportunities available through the center.

item.title: Columbia City Connect Recognized As Nationally Accredited Main Street
item.description: Columbia City Connect has earned nationally accredited Main Street status, the highest recognition within the Indiana Main Street program.

item.title: Attendees Grow Their Knowledge At WACF Conservation and Coffee
item.description: Despite a rainy morning, nearly every seat was filled at the Wawasee Area Conservancy Foundation’s Levinson-LaBrosse Education Center as residents gathered 9-11 a.m. Saturday, March 7 for the organization’s monthly Conservation & Coffee program.

item.title: Syracuse Public Library – SPL Holds Annual Leprechaun Trap Program
item.description: Syracuse Public Library needs creative children to craft unique leprechaun traps, which will be used to relocate leprechauns to their natural habitat: the green fields of Ireland.

item.title: South Bend Approves $7.8M For Streetscape Project, River Pedestrian Bridge
item.description: The South Bend Redevelopment Commission has approved nearly $7.8 million in funding for a streetscape overhaul on Colfax Avenue and construction of a new pedestrian bridge over the St. Joseph River.

item.title: America in the 1840s: A Decade of Movement, Conflict and New Possibilities
item.description: The 1840s were years of rapid change in the United States, marked by migration, war and debates over what the nation would become.

item.title: Indiana Attorney General’s Office Appeals Religious Freedom Ruling On State Abortion Ban
item.description: Attorney General Todd Rokita has appealed a Marion County judge’s ruling blocking Indiana’s near-total abortion ban for a select group of Hoosiers who argue their religious freedom requires access to an abortion.

item.title: H&R Block made a mistake on my taxes. Why won’t it help me?
item.description: When Lance Croft gets hit with $14,000 in IRS penalties, he discovers that his H&R Block tax preparer missed a page on his return.
